The '''Sentry Droid X-5''' was a model of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] at the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. A number of them were used to defend the exterior of the factory during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Security Droid BXs appear as enemies in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found outside of the Okara Droid Factory on the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
